data_sources.name: Hazard distances
data_sources.detail: US DOT Emergency Response Guidebook, Table 1

limitations: This is a planning tool, not a dispersion model. Zones follow ERG guidance, not a plume simulation; terrain, buildings and lake breeze are ignored.
Population is estimated per Census block. We show areas with the most residents who need help — never individuals or households.
Traffic is modeled as flow on a road network; signals, crashes and driver behavior are simplified.
Compliance and mobilization times are assumptions, not measurements.
Bus routing assumes every bus starts at the garage and is available immediately.
Results are only as good as OpenStreetMap and Census data for downtown Madison.
